figurative_meaning_en: Generous; liberal in spending; open-handed in giving
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার দরাজ হস্তের জন্য সকলে তাকে সম্মান করে।
দানে দরাজ হস্ত থাকলে জীবন সুখী হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone respects him for his open-handed generosity.
Being open-handed in giving leads to a happy life.
note: The idiom draws from traditional Bengali values emphasizing generosity in rural and communal settings.
